| **linear vector builder `vec_conj_lin`** (vec.vs) | no global; the root's own cell `VEC_META_OFF + 4` (+408, "outside the seal") = 1 marks "every node under the root was made by this construction" | ordinary allocator blocks (root, 1→2→4→…→32-slot tail leaves, trie nodes) | — | mutates **in place**: the element's 64-B slot into the tail leaf (`slot_store`), the leaf's running digest (`vec_leaf_append_hash`), the root's tail slot, `TAIL_LEN`, `COUNT`; a tail at capacity "moves to one twice its length and the old leaf … is freed"; a full tail (32) runs the persistent `vec_conj_off` and **copies its result's payload into the same root**, then frees the temporary root and (owned, uncounted roots only) the interior nodes `push_tail` cloned away. Runs under `ThreadUnsafe_EVE_DEFER_SEAL` (the pending vector seal — digests computed once, on demand: "26 % of the process inside SHA-256, 95 % of it this row's per-push seals" before) | vs/src/vs/kernel/wasm/vec.vs:875–917, :936–945, :985–990, :1003–1010, :1027, :1033–1051, :1056–1080, :1093–1094 — code read |
| …its guard | `tally_linear_guard(root)`: `ow = read_page_owner(page_of root)`; traps when `ow ≠ 0` and `ow ≠ alloc_current_thread_id` | — | — | **The guard is the block's page owner, nothing in the block.** A root on an owner-0 page passes ("no one's to attribute"). A root on an *adopted* page (owner `PT_ADOPTED_OWNER`) or a block page therefore **traps** for every thread. A counted root is written in place too, under the store rule (hold the new leaf, release the old) — "leak over use-after-free (rule 12), never a free" | vec.vs:964–981, :1014–1024, :1083–1094; tally.vs:1233–1237, :1262–1265 — code read |

What this table says for static Eve:
- **Every per-thread structure at this pin is made of allocator blocks at final slab addresses.** Thread-locality is a *naming* property (a wasm global is the only root) plus a *tally* property (allocated quiet or manual, so no scope log notes it). None is a region the thread bump-fills; the only bump allocators in the kernel are BLOCK PAGES (eve.vs:2810–2951, VS-KERNEL.md §2.5) and the link arena (boot.vs:12637–12648, a process that exits).
- **"Scratch" in practice is wider than rule 12's wording.** bnd.vs and the four `$tmemo` tables hold counted values (condition (b) fails as written) and are licensed as "per-thread memos (Q3)" / a per-thread holder; hmemo.vs and the seal reserve (eve.vs:943–968) are the two that meet all four literally. Neither memo family is freed at thread exit (grep above) — condition (d) is met as "never adopted by anything", not as "thrown away".
- **Ownership of an in-place builder is read from the page header** (`PHV2_OWNER` via `page_of`), for both the transient (`tl_owner_is_me`, tally.vs:1236–1237) and the linear conj. A builder working in a region with no owner-stamped page header has no guard to pass or fail by design — it either traps (adopted owner) or is unguarded (owner 0).
